title: The Quiet Applause
synopsis: As Gi-yeol and Sunhee, a couple who run a sheep ranch, consider placing their disabled eldest son, Songpul, in a care facility, their youngest daughter, Songsan, who has long yearned for their love, is forced to confront complex emotions as she faces a decision that threatens to tear her family apart.

title: Peafowl
synopsis:
There still might be hope in this town where I was born and denied.
 
Myung is a transgender who cut ties with her family and hometown because of who she is. Now, all she needs is the surgery but the only way to earn money, by winning the Waacking dance competition, didn’t go well. One day, she receives a call that her father passed away and Myung finds out that her father left a will that he will give her the legacy if she performs Drum Dance during his 49th memorial ritual. With no choice left, Myung goes back to her hometown to perform according to her father’s will.

title: God’s Daughter Dances
synopsis: Shin-mi, a transgender dancer, receives a notice to undergo her mandatory military service examination. Fully prepared, she confidently makes her way to the Military Manpower Administration.

title: Hands and Wings
synopsis: Mi-sook has been assisting her disabled son, Woo-sung, with masturbation because his condition prevents him from doing it himself. One day, Woo-sung unexpectedly rejects his mother's help.

title: The Chicken of Wuzuh
synopsis: Wuzuh, a girl with Down syndrome, creates chaos at school with her pet chicken after discovering her secret crush, her teacher, gave another student the same hairclip he gave her.
